# Crowd Light Show — turn the audience's phones into one synchronized light show

Source: https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/

### Event & party organizers

Give every guest a glowing role in the night.

Free and open source. No wristbands to buy, no app to install — the lights are already in the crowd's hands. They scan a QR; you drive the whole room by hand or from your VJ rig, in time with the music.

Who it's for

From an intimate first dance to a packed stadium — if you have a crowd and a song, you have a light show.

Give every guest a glowing role in the night.

Turn the whole field into your stage lighting.

Drop the beat and the whole floor flashes with it.

A shimmer of light wrapped around the first dance.

Light the room in your brand colors on cue.

Erupt the stands in color on every goal.

Unite the congregation in one moving moment.

The whole hall lights up for the big night.

Why it works

No wristbands to buy, ship, charge or collect. The lights are already in the crowd's hands.

One synchronized wave of light the whole crowd creates together — the kind of moment people film and remember.

No wristbands or LEDs to buy. It uses the phones people are already holding.

Guests just scan a QR and join in their browser. Nothing to download, nothing to sign up for.

Screen light works everywhere; on Android the real flashlight fires too — for an extra-bright wave.

Build the show around your music. Every flash lands exactly on the beat, in perfect sync.

Run the whole thing from a laptop. Build the playlist, project the QR, press GO.

Flash-rate limited with a photosensitivity warning and consent, so the show stays fun for everyone.

The control room

One laptop or tablet runs the whole show — from a single “GO” to VJ-grade live control, all in the browser.

Grab saturation, colour, brightness and flash and ride them under the music — like a VJ console, right in the browser. Open it fullscreen and mix with your fingers on a tablet.

Upload a track and the lights follow the music. Layer a separate camera-flash channel, fire one-tap synchronized fireworks, scroll a message across every phone, or hit BLACKOUT — the music keeps playing.

Restrict the whole crowd to a flag’s or a brand’s palette — pick colours on the wheel and everything snaps to the nearest one. Perfect for a product launch, a club night, or a team’s colours.

Already run Resolume, TouchOSC or Bitfocus Companion? Drive the crowd’s phones from the console you already use, over OSC — a tiny bridge runs on your own laptop, no cloud lock-in.

Use cases

A few ways people turn a crowd's phones into something unforgettable.

The chorus hits, you press GO, and in an instant five hundred phones flash gold in perfect unison — a single golden pulse rolling across the whole crowd, right on the downbeat.

As the couple steps onto the floor, every guest's phone breathes a soft warm shimmer around them — a glow that wraps the room without a single spotlight rig.

Three… two… one — the whole venue strobes brighter with every number, then explodes into a full-color burst as the clock hits zero.

The ball hits the net and the stands ignite — thousands of phones flashing your team's colors in a wave that circles the whole arena.

At the reveal, the entire room turns your exact brand color on cue — a launch image that lands in every attendee's camera roll.

How it works

No rigging, no installs, no rehearsal. From laptop to lit-up room in minutes.

You upload your playlist on a laptop and project a QR code on screen — or print it on the tickets.

People point their phone camera at the QR and join in seconds — straight in the browser, no app needed.

Hit GO and every phone flashes to the music, perfectly in sync — one light show across the whole room.

Pricing

The app is free and open-source (Apache-2.0) — self-host it with no limits, or try the hosted demo. The paid tiers are an optional managed service: we plan, set up, operate and tune your show on the night. Final scope is confirmed on a quick call.

Free

self-host or demo

Run the full app yourself with no limits — Docker, open source. Or try the hosted demo here. No per-person fee, no wristbands, no app for your crowd.

Spark

up to 100 phones

Parties, weddings, small venues — one operator, on good Wi-Fi.

Surge

up to 1,000 phones

Clubs, mid-size concerts, conferences — soundcheck + on-site operation.

Prices are starting points and depend on venue, audience size and network conditions — confirmed on a consult call. No payment here; every tier starts with a conversation.

Open the live demo, scan the QR with your phone, and watch your own screen join the show. Grab a few phones for the full effect.

Seen in the wild

It's a real moment people create — a wave of phone light across a stadium or a concert. Crowd Light Show turns it into a show you actually control: one operator drives every colour, flash and effect live, and the music plays in sync on every phone.

---

# About &amp; safety · Crowd Light Show

Source: https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/about

Crowd Light Show is a free, open-source web app that turns a crowd's phones into one light show synchronized to the music.

The show flashes bright light. People with photosensitive epilepsy or sensitivity to flashing light should not take part. Flash rate is capped to no more than 3 flashes per second and large saturated-red strobing is blocked (per WCAG 2.3.1/2.3.2), but please use judgement. You can leave any time with the “Stop” button.

Taking part in a show is anonymous — no account, no name, no email, and the join/show page sets **no analytics cookies**. If you enable the flashlight on Android, the browser asks for camera permission because that is how the web exposes the LED; **no image is ever opened, recorded or sent** — the camera is used only to switch the light on and off. Session data is discarded when the show ends. The marketing website itself uses Google Analytics **only if you accept the cookie banner** — see the [privacy notice](https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/privacy) for details.

Licensed under [Apache-2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). Source: [github.com/AndriiShramko/crowd-light-show](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/crowd-light-show). You're free to use, run and modify it.

Free for any use. Want it customized, integrated, supported, or extended for your event/venue? Contact **Andrii Shramko** — [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrii-shramko/) · [zmei116@gmail.com](mailto:zmei116@gmail.com) · [book a call](https://calendar.app.google/Ff729HqGk4RpzPNDA). Let's talk.

**Music licensing** for public performance is the organizer's responsibility (in Poland: ZAiKS and related societies).

---

# Privacy &amp; Imprint · Crowd Light Show

Source: https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/privacy

For the contact / lead form on this site. Last updated 2026-06-29.

| Provider | Andrii Shramko— sole trader (jednoosobowa działalność gospodarcza, CEIDG, Poland) |
| NIP | 7543116302 |
| Contact | [zmei116@gmail.com](mailto:zmei116@gmail.com)·[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrii-shramko/) |
| Service | Crowd Light Show — open-source app + optional managed light-show service |

English (authoritative)

The data controller is Andrii Shramko (details in the imprint above). Contact for any privacy request: [zmei116@gmail.com](mailto:zmei116@gmail.com).

When you submit the contact form we collect your **name and email** (required) and, if you choose, your **phone, company, event type and message**. We use them solely to reply to your enquiry and scope a possible light-show service. The legal basis is taking steps at your request prior to a possible contract (GDPR/RODO Art. 6(1)(b)).

In a SQLite database inside our application container on a server in the EU (Hetzner, Finland). When notifications are enabled, a message saying only “a new lead arrived” is sent to the owner via Telegram — **your personal details are not sent over Telegram**.

Up to 12 months from our last contact about your enquiry, then it is deleted. Backups inherit the same period.

On this website — but **not** on the live light-show / join page — we use **Google Analytics 4** to understand **in aggregate** how the app is used: roughly how many people tried it, how many phones joined a session and how long shows lasted. It runs **only after you accept** in the cookie banner; consent is **off by default**, so until you accept no analytics cookies are set and no analytics data is collected. IP addresses are anonymized and Google’s advertising features are not used. You can change or withdraw your choice anytime via “Cookie settings” at the bottom of the page. Provider: Google Ireland Ltd.; this may involve a transfer to Google LLC under the EU Standard Contractual Clauses. Legal basis: your consent (GDPR/RODO Art. 6(1)(a)).

If you upload your own audio to run a light show, the file is analyzed into a light timeline and is also **stored and streamed to the phones in your session** so everyone hears the music in sync. It is kept only for that purpose and **deleted automatically when you close the page (after a short grace period) or within 24 hours**, whichever comes first; it is not published anywhere beyond your session, not linked to your identity, and not used for anything else. You are responsible for holding the rights to any music you upload — public performance may require a licence from a collecting society (in Poland, ZAiKS). This feature is off unless the operator enables it.

You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction or object to the processing, and withdraw any consent — email us and we will action it. You may also lodge a complaint with the Polish supervisory authority (UODO, uodo.gov.pl).

Polski (wiążący)

Administratorem danych jest Andrii Shramko (dane w stopce powyżej). Kontakt w sprawach prywatności: [zmei116@gmail.com](mailto:zmei116@gmail.com).

Po wysłaniu formularza kontaktowego zbieramy Twoje **imię i e-mail** (wymagane) oraz — jeśli zechcesz — **telefon, firmę, typ wydarzenia i wiadomość**. Używamy ich wyłącznie po to, by odpowiedzieć na zapytanie i wycenić ewentualną usługę pokazu świateł. Podstawą prawną są działania na Twoje żądanie przed ewentualną umową (RODO art. 6 ust. 1 lit. b).

W bazie SQLite w kontenerze naszej aplikacji na serwerze w UE (Hetzner, Finlandia). Gdy powiadomienia są włączone, do właściciela wysyłana jest przez Telegram tylko informacja „nowe zgłoszenie” — **Twoje dane osobowe nie są przesyłane przez Telegram**.

Do 12 miesięcy od ostatniego kontaktu w sprawie zapytania, potem są usuwane. Kopie zapasowe podlegają temu samemu okresowi.

Na tej stronie internetowej — ale **nie** na stronie pokazu / dołączania — używamy **Google Analytics 4**, aby **zbiorczo** rozumieć, jak korzysta się z aplikacji: w przybliżeniu ile osób ją wypróbowało, ile telefonów dołączyło do sesji i jak długo trwały pokazy. Działa to **dopiero po wyrażeniu zgody** w banerze cookie; zgoda jest **domyślnie wyłączona**, więc do czasu jej udzielenia nie są zapisywane żadne pliki cookie analityczne ani zbierane dane. Adresy IP są anonimizowane, a funkcje reklamowe Google nie są używane. Wybór możesz zmienić lub wycofać w każdej chwili przez „Ustawienia cookie” na dole strony. Dostawca: Google Ireland Ltd.; może to wiązać się z przekazaniem danych do Google LLC na podstawie standardowych klauzul umownych UE. Podstawa prawna: Twoja zgoda (RODO art. 6 ust. 1 lit. a).

Jeśli prześlesz własne audio, aby uruchomić pokaz świateł, plik jest analizowany do osi czasu świateł oraz **przechowywany i przesyłany do telefonów w Twojej sesji**, aby wszyscy słyszeli muzykę zsynchronizowaną. Jest przechowywany wyłącznie w tym celu i **automatycznie usuwany po zamknięciu strony (po krótkim okresie karencji) lub w ciągu 24 godzin**, w zależności od tego, co nastąpi wcześniej; nie jest publikowany poza Twoją sesją, nie jest powiązany z Twoją tożsamością ani używany do innych celów. Odpowiadasz za posiadanie praw do przesyłanej muzyki — publiczne odtwarzanie może wymagać licencji organizacji zbiorowego zarządzania (w Polsce ZAiKS). Funkcja jest wyłączona, o ile operator jej nie włączy.

Masz prawo do dostępu, sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia lub sprzeciwu wobec przetwarzania oraz wycofania zgody — napisz do nas, a zrealizujemy żądanie. Możesz też złożyć skargę do Prezesa UODO (uodo.gov.pl).

# Crowd Light Show — turn the audience's phones into one synchronized light show

Source: https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/?lang=en

### Event & party organizers

Give every guest a glowing role in the night.

Free and open source. No wristbands to buy, no app to install — the lights are already in the crowd's hands. They scan a QR; you drive the whole room by hand or from your VJ rig, in time with the music.

Who it's for

From an intimate first dance to a packed stadium — if you have a crowd and a song, you have a light show.

Give every guest a glowing role in the night.

Turn the whole field into your stage lighting.

Drop the beat and the whole floor flashes with it.

A shimmer of light wrapped around the first dance.

Light the room in your brand colors on cue.

Erupt the stands in color on every goal.

Unite the congregation in one moving moment.

The whole hall lights up for the big night.

Why it works

No wristbands to buy, ship, charge or collect. The lights are already in the crowd's hands.

One synchronized wave of light the whole crowd creates together — the kind of moment people film and remember.

No wristbands or LEDs to buy. It uses the phones people are already holding.

Guests just scan a QR and join in their browser. Nothing to download, nothing to sign up for.

Screen light works everywhere; on Android the real flashlight fires too — for an extra-bright wave.

Build the show around your music. Every flash lands exactly on the beat, in perfect sync.

Run the whole thing from a laptop. Build the playlist, project the QR, press GO.

Flash-rate limited with a photosensitivity warning and consent, so the show stays fun for everyone.

The control room

One laptop or tablet runs the whole show — from a single “GO” to VJ-grade live control, all in the browser.

Grab saturation, colour, brightness and flash and ride them under the music — like a VJ console, right in the browser. Open it fullscreen and mix with your fingers on a tablet.

Upload a track and the lights follow the music. Layer a separate camera-flash channel, fire one-tap synchronized fireworks, scroll a message across every phone, or hit BLACKOUT — the music keeps playing.

Restrict the whole crowd to a flag’s or a brand’s palette — pick colours on the wheel and everything snaps to the nearest one. Perfect for a product launch, a club night, or a team’s colours.

Already run Resolume, TouchOSC or Bitfocus Companion? Drive the crowd’s phones from the console you already use, over OSC — a tiny bridge runs on your own laptop, no cloud lock-in.

Use cases

A few ways people turn a crowd's phones into something unforgettable.

The chorus hits, you press GO, and in an instant five hundred phones flash gold in perfect unison — a single golden pulse rolling across the whole crowd, right on the downbeat.

As the couple steps onto the floor, every guest's phone breathes a soft warm shimmer around them — a glow that wraps the room without a single spotlight rig.

Three… two… one — the whole venue strobes brighter with every number, then explodes into a full-color burst as the clock hits zero.

The ball hits the net and the stands ignite — thousands of phones flashing your team's colors in a wave that circles the whole arena.

At the reveal, the entire room turns your exact brand color on cue — a launch image that lands in every attendee's camera roll.

How it works

No rigging, no installs, no rehearsal. From laptop to lit-up room in minutes.

You upload your playlist on a laptop and project a QR code on screen — or print it on the tickets.

People point their phone camera at the QR and join in seconds — straight in the browser, no app needed.

Hit GO and every phone flashes to the music, perfectly in sync — one light show across the whole room.

Pricing

The app is free and open-source (Apache-2.0) — self-host it with no limits, or try the hosted demo. The paid tiers are an optional managed service: we plan, set up, operate and tune your show on the night. Final scope is confirmed on a quick call.

Free

self-host or demo

Run the full app yourself with no limits — Docker, open source. Or try the hosted demo here. No per-person fee, no wristbands, no app for your crowd.

Spark

up to 100 phones

Parties, weddings, small venues — one operator, on good Wi-Fi.

Surge

up to 1,000 phones

Clubs, mid-size concerts, conferences — soundcheck + on-site operation.

Prices are starting points and depend on venue, audience size and network conditions — confirmed on a consult call. No payment here; every tier starts with a conversation.

Open the live demo, scan the QR with your phone, and watch your own screen join the show. Grab a few phones for the full effect.

Seen in the wild

It's a real moment people create — a wave of phone light across a stadium or a concert. Crowd Light Show turns it into a show you actually control: one operator drives every colour, flash and effect live, and the music plays in sync on every phone.

Three… two… one — the whole venue strobes brighter with every number, then explodes into a full-color burst as the clock hits zero.

The ball hits the net and the stands ignite — thousands of phones flashing your team's colors in a wave that circles the whole arena.

At the reveal, the entire room turns your exact brand color on cue — a launch image that lands in every attendee's camera roll.

How it works

No rigging, no installs, no rehearsal. From laptop to lit-up room in minutes.

You upload your playlist on a laptop and project a QR code on screen — or print it on the tickets.

People point their phone camera at the QR and join in seconds — straight in the browser, no app needed.

Hit GO and every phone flashes to the music, perfectly in sync — one light show across the whole room.

Pricing

The app is free and open-source (Apache-2.0) — self-host it with no limits, or try the hosted demo. The paid tiers are an optional managed service: we plan, set up, operate and tune your show on the night. Final scope is confirmed on a quick call.

Free

self-host or demo

Run the full app yourself with no limits — Docker, open source. Or try the hosted demo here. No per-person fee, no wristbands, no app for your crowd.

Spark

up to 100 phones

Parties, weddings, small venues — one operator, on good Wi-Fi.

Surge

up to 1,000 phones

Clubs, mid-size concerts, conferences — soundcheck + on-site operation.

Prices are starting points and depend on venue, audience size and network conditions — confirmed on a consult call. No payment here; every tier starts with a conversation.

Open the live demo, scan the QR with your phone, and watch your own screen join the show. Grab a few phones for the full effect.

Seen in the wild

It's a real moment people create — a wave of phone light across a stadium or a concert. Crowd Light Show turns it into a show you actually control: one operator drives every colour, flash and effect live, and the music plays in sync on every phone.

# Operator · Crowd Light Show

Source: https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/studio

Connected: … · Audience: **0** · Free disk: –Phones joined: **0**

Armed: **—** · State: idle

Fine offset (ms) between the music and the lights. + = lights later, − = earlier. Set once at soundcheck.

Switch the whole crowd live. Spatial presets use each phone's place in the crowd. Every preset is safety-clamped on the server (≤3 flashes/s, no red strobe). Arm + GO a track, then raise “Music reactivity” to make a preset breathe with the song.

Pick a preset to go live. (This is separate from the music timeline above.)

Its own patterns & its own reactivity, independent of the screen presets above. Drives the **camera LED on Android**; on iPhone the web has no torch — those phones light the **screen** instead. Safety-clamped ≤3 flashes/s.

Flash reach: —

Pick a flash pattern (independent of the screen).

One-tap firework bursts — a few seconds of synchronized flash across every phone (screen + flash), then the show resumes exactly where it was. Safety-clamped ≤3 flashes/s.

Live text that scrolls across every phone in this show — announce a song, a name, a shout-out. Leave blank and Clear to remove. (Text only — it never affects the lights.)

Drive the crowd by hand — saturation, colour, brightness, flash — like a VJ console. Toggle it on, pick a layout, open fullscreen and play with your fingers under the music. Safety-clamped ≤3 flashes/s. Turn it off and the show behaves exactly as before.

Restrict the whole show to a flag's or a brand's colours — everything snaps to the nearest one. Works with or without the manual controls.

Plug a USB MIDI fader/pad box into this computer (Chrome or Edge on desktop). Connect, then “Learn” a fader for each value — it drives the same 4 controls as your fingers.

Leads from the landing page form appear here.

What every visitor to the public [/studio](https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/studio) console starts with. Your personal shows here are separate — these are just the public defaults. Tracks you tick “Show publicly” above appear in the public playlist.

# VJ &amp; OSC guide — Crowd Light Show

Source: https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/vj

# VJ & OSC guide

Drive the crowd's phones by hand, or from the professional software you already run — Resolume, TouchOSC, Bitfocus Companion, or any OSC source. Optional WebMIDI maps a hardware fader/pad box.

## 1 · The VJ pult (nothing to install)

Open the console at [/studio](https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/studio) (or `/operator` for the main show), press **Start**, then open **“🎛️ VJ pult”** and switch **Manual control** on. You get four touch layouts — **Faders**, **Colour wheel**, **XY pad**, and **Big pads** — plus a fullscreen button. Toggle **“intervene in preset”** (the running preset keeps going and your moves ride on top) or **“manual only”** (presets off, the colour is purely yours). The **Palette** section locks the whole crowd to a flag's or a brand's colours — pick them on the wheel or tap a flag.

Everything is safety-clamped on every phone: at most 3 flashes per second, no red strobe — you can't push it past that no matter how hard you ride the faders.

## 2 · Drive it from Resolume / TouchOSC / Companion (OSC)

A tiny **bridge** runs on your own laptop. It listens for OSC over UDP and forwards each message to the show over HTTPS — so nothing new is opened on the show server, and it works through NAT and TLS. It's zero-dependency Node; the source is in [ tools/vj-bridge/](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/crowd-light-show/tree/main/tools/vj-bridge).

### Run the bridge

Grab your room's token from `/studio` (it's `window.__SESSION__.token` in the page), then:

```
node tools/vj-bridge/bridge.mjs \
  --api https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu \
  --token "$CLS_CONSOLE_TOKEN" \
  --osc-port 9000 --osc-host 0.0.0.0
```
For the main show instead of a `/studio` room, pass `--operator-pass "$OP_PASS"` in place of `--token`.

### Point your software at it

- **Resolume Arena/Avenue:**Preferences → OSC → enable Output, IP = the bridge laptop (- `127.0.0.1`if it's the same machine), Outgoing port =- `9000`. Then in Shortcuts → Edit OSC, map a fader to- `/cls/manual/hue`or a clip to- `/cls/fx`with value- `salute`.
- **TouchOSC / Lemur:**add an OSC connection, host = the bridge laptop's IP, send port- `9000`, address your controls- `/cls/*`.
- **Bitfocus Companion (no bridge needed for buttons):**add a- **Generic HTTP**connection to- `https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu`; on a button, POST to- `/api/console/fx`with header- `Authorization: Bearer <token>`and body- `{"name":"salute"}`.

### OSC address map (`/cls/*`)

  | Address | Args | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `/cls/manual/hue` | f 0..1 | colour (×360), auto-enables manual |
| `/cls/manual/sat` | f 0..1 | saturation |
| `/cls/manual/bri` | f 0..1 | brightness |
| `/cls/manual/flash` | f 0..1 | flash (torch) intensity |
| `/cls/manual/on` | f ≥0.5 | enable / disable the manual layer |
| `/cls/manual/mode` | s | `intervene`or`full` |
| `/cls/palette` | s | restrict to colours, e.g. `"e30613,ffffff"` |
| `/cls/preset` | s | `pulse`,`rainbow_chase`,`color_waves`,`ocean`,`off` |
| `/cls/torch` | s | `beat`,`strobe`,`sparkle`,`off` |
| `/cls/fx` | s / button | firework: `salute`,`twinkle`,`ripple`,`strobe_burst`,`color_burst` |
| `/cls/blackout` | — | blackout (lights only; music keeps playing) |
| `/cls/seek` | f ms | jump the music + lights |
| `/cls/mute` | f ≥0.5 | mute the music on every phone |
| `/cls/marquee` | s | scrolling text on every phone |

**It stays safe.** Every command is re-validated and re-governed on the server and is scoped to your own room by a signed token — even hostile OSC can't exceed the epilepsy-safety limits or drive another show.

## 3 · WebMIDI (a hardware controller)

On the laptop running the console, plug in a USB MIDI fader/pad box (Korg nanoKONTROL, Akai APCmini, …). In the pult's **MIDI controller** panel press **Connect**, then **Learn** a fader for each value — wiggle the control to bind it. Faders map to the four values; note pads fire the flash. Chrome or Edge on desktop only; the mapping is remembered.

## 4 · Self-host it

The whole app is open source (Apache-2.0). Run it yourself with Docker and drive it exactly the same way — see the [repository](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/crowd-light-show) and the [bridge README](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/crowd-light-show/tree/main/tools/vj-bridge).

---

# Crowd Light Show — turn the audience's phones into one synchronized light show

Source: https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/?tier=spark

### Event & party organizers

Give every guest a glowing role in the night.

Free and open source. No wristbands to buy, no app to install — the lights are already in the crowd's hands. They scan a QR; you drive the whole room by hand or from your VJ rig, in time with the music.

Who it's for

From an intimate first dance to a packed stadium — if you have a crowd and a song, you have a light show.

Give every guest a glowing role in the night.

Turn the whole field into your stage lighting.

Drop the beat and the whole floor flashes with it.

A shimmer of light wrapped around the first dance.

Light the room in your brand colors on cue.

Erupt the stands in color on every goal.

Unite the congregation in one moving moment.

The whole hall lights up for the big night.

Why it works

No wristbands to buy, ship, charge or collect. The lights are already in the crowd's hands.

One synchronized wave of light the whole crowd creates together — the kind of moment people film and remember.

No wristbands or LEDs to buy. It uses the phones people are already holding.

Guests just scan a QR and join in their browser. Nothing to download, nothing to sign up for.

Screen light works everywhere; on Android the real flashlight fires too — for an extra-bright wave.

Build the show around your music. Every flash lands exactly on the beat, in perfect sync.

Run the whole thing from a laptop. Build the playlist, project the QR, press GO.

Flash-rate limited with a photosensitivity warning and consent, so the show stays fun for everyone.

The control room

One laptop or tablet runs the whole show — from a single “GO” to VJ-grade live control, all in the browser.

Grab saturation, colour, brightness and flash and ride them under the music — like a VJ console, right in the browser. Open it fullscreen and mix with your fingers on a tablet.

Upload a track and the lights follow the music. Layer a separate camera-flash channel, fire one-tap synchronized fireworks, scroll a message across every phone, or hit BLACKOUT — the music keeps playing.

Restrict the whole crowd to a flag’s or a brand’s palette — pick colours on the wheel and everything snaps to the nearest one. Perfect for a product launch, a club night, or a team’s colours.

Already run Resolume, TouchOSC or Bitfocus Companion? Drive the crowd’s phones from the console you already use, over OSC — a tiny bridge runs on your own laptop, no cloud lock-in.

Use cases

A few ways people turn a crowd's phones into something unforgettable.

The chorus hits, you press GO, and in an instant five hundred phones flash gold in perfect unison — a single golden pulse rolling across the whole crowd, right on the downbeat.

As the couple steps onto the floor, every guest's phone breathes a soft warm shimmer around them — a glow that wraps the room without a single spotlight rig.

Three… two… one — the whole venue strobes brighter with every number, then explodes into a full-color burst as the clock hits zero.

The ball hits the net and the stands ignite — thousands of phones flashing your team's colors in a wave that circles the whole arena.

At the reveal, the entire room turns your exact brand color on cue — a launch image that lands in every attendee's camera roll.

How it works

No rigging, no installs, no rehearsal. From laptop to lit-up room in minutes.

You upload your playlist on a laptop and project a QR code on screen — or print it on the tickets.

People point their phone camera at the QR and join in seconds — straight in the browser, no app needed.

Hit GO and every phone flashes to the music, perfectly in sync — one light show across the whole room.

Pricing

The app is free and open-source (Apache-2.0) — self-host it with no limits, or try the hosted demo. The paid tiers are an optional managed service: we plan, set up, operate and tune your show on the night. Final scope is confirmed on a quick call.

Free

self-host or demo

Run the full app yourself with no limits — Docker, open source. Or try the hosted demo here. No per-person fee, no wristbands, no app for your crowd.

Spark

up to 100 phones

Parties, weddings, small venues — one operator, on good Wi-Fi.

Surge

up to 1,000 phones

Clubs, mid-size concerts, conferences — soundcheck + on-site operation.

Prices are starting points and depend on venue, audience size and network conditions — confirmed on a consult call. No payment here; every tier starts with a conversation.

Open the live demo, scan the QR with your phone, and watch your own screen join the show. Grab a few phones for the full effect.

Seen in the wild

# Privacy &amp; Imprint · Crowd Light Show

Source: https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/privacy?lang=en

For the contact / lead form on this site. Last updated 2026-06-29.

| Provider | Andrii Shramko— sole trader (jednoosobowa działalność gospodarcza, CEIDG, Poland) |
| NIP | 7543116302 |
| Contact | [zmei116@gmail.com](mailto:zmei116@gmail.com)·[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrii-shramko/) |
| Service | Crowd Light Show — open-source app + optional managed light-show service |

English (authoritative)

The data controller is Andrii Shramko (details in the imprint above). Contact for any privacy request: [zmei116@gmail.com](mailto:zmei116@gmail.com).

When you submit the contact form we collect your **name and email** (required) and, if you choose, your **phone, company, event type and message**. We use them solely to reply to your enquiry and scope a possible light-show service. The legal basis is taking steps at your request prior to a possible contract (GDPR/RODO Art. 6(1)(b)).

In a SQLite database inside our application container on a server in the EU (Hetzner, Finland). When notifications are enabled, a message saying only “a new lead arrived” is sent to the owner via Telegram — **your personal details are not sent over Telegram**.

Up to 12 months from our last contact about your enquiry, then it is deleted. Backups inherit the same period.

On this website — but **not** on the live light-show / join page — we use **Google Analytics 4** to understand **in aggregate** how the app is used: roughly how many people tried it, how many phones joined a session and how long shows lasted. It runs **only after you accept** in the cookie banner; consent is **off by default**, so until you accept no analytics cookies are set and no analytics data is collected. IP addresses are anonymized and Google’s advertising features are not used. You can change or withdraw your choice anytime via “Cookie settings” at the bottom of the page. Provider: Google Ireland Ltd.; this may involve a transfer to Google LLC under the EU Standard Contractual Clauses. Legal basis: your consent (GDPR/RODO Art. 6(1)(a)).

If you upload your own audio to run a light show, the file is analyzed into a light timeline and is also **stored and streamed to the phones in your session** so everyone hears the music in sync. It is kept only for that purpose and **deleted automatically when you close the page (after a short grace period) or within 24 hours**, whichever comes first; it is not published anywhere beyond your session, not linked to your identity, and not used for anything else. You are responsible for holding the rights to any music you upload — public performance may require a licence from a collecting society (in Poland, ZAiKS). This feature is off unless the operator enables it.

You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction or object to the processing, and withdraw any consent — email us and we will action it. You may also lodge a complaint with the Polish supervisory authority (UODO, uodo.gov.pl).

Polski (wiążący)

Administratorem danych jest Andrii Shramko (dane w stopce powyżej). Kontakt w sprawach prywatności: [zmei116@gmail.com](mailto:zmei116@gmail.com).

Po wysłaniu formularza kontaktowego zbieramy Twoje **imię i e-mail** (wymagane) oraz — jeśli zechcesz — **telefon, firmę, typ wydarzenia i wiadomość**. Używamy ich wyłącznie po to, by odpowiedzieć na zapytanie i wycenić ewentualną usługę pokazu świateł. Podstawą prawną są działania na Twoje żądanie przed ewentualną umową (RODO art. 6 ust. 1 lit. b).

W bazie SQLite w kontenerze naszej aplikacji na serwerze w UE (Hetzner, Finlandia). Gdy powiadomienia są włączone, do właściciela wysyłana jest przez Telegram tylko informacja „nowe zgłoszenie” — **Twoje dane osobowe nie są przesyłane przez Telegram**.

Do 12 miesięcy od ostatniego kontaktu w sprawie zapytania, potem są usuwane. Kopie zapasowe podlegają temu samemu okresowi.

Na tej stronie internetowej — ale **nie** na stronie pokazu / dołączania — używamy **Google Analytics 4**, aby **zbiorczo** rozumieć, jak korzysta się z aplikacji: w przybliżeniu ile osób ją wypróbowało, ile telefonów dołączyło do sesji i jak długo trwały pokazy. Działa to **dopiero po wyrażeniu zgody** w banerze cookie; zgoda jest **domyślnie wyłączona**, więc do czasu jej udzielenia nie są zapisywane żadne pliki cookie analityczne ani zbierane dane. Adresy IP są anonimizowane, a funkcje reklamowe Google nie są używane. Wybór możesz zmienić lub wycofać w każdej chwili przez „Ustawienia cookie” na dole strony. Dostawca: Google Ireland Ltd.; może to wiązać się z przekazaniem danych do Google LLC na podstawie standardowych klauzul umownych UE. Podstawa prawna: Twoja zgoda (RODO art. 6 ust. 1 lit. a).

Jeśli prześlesz własne audio, aby uruchomić pokaz świateł, plik jest analizowany do osi czasu świateł oraz **przechowywany i przesyłany do telefonów w Twojej sesji**, aby wszyscy słyszeli muzykę zsynchronizowaną. Jest przechowywany wyłącznie w tym celu i **automatycznie usuwany po zamknięciu strony (po krótkim okresie karencji) lub w ciągu 24 godzin**, w zależności od tego, co nastąpi wcześniej; nie jest publikowany poza Twoją sesją, nie jest powiązany z Twoją tożsamością ani używany do innych celów. Odpowiadasz za posiadanie praw do przesyłanej muzyki — publiczne odtwarzanie może wymagać licencji organizacji zbiorowego zarządzania (w Polsce ZAiKS). Funkcja jest wyłączona, o ile operator jej nie włączy.

Masz prawo do dostępu, sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia lub sprzeciwu wobec przetwarzania oraz wycofania zgody — napisz do nas, a zrealizujemy żądanie. Możesz też złożyć skargę do Prezesa UODO (uodo.gov.pl).

# Crowd Light Show — turn the audience's phones into one synchronized light show

Source: https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/?utm=share

### Event & party organizers

Give every guest a glowing role in the night.

Free and open source. No wristbands to buy, no app to install — the lights are already in the crowd's hands. They scan a QR; you drive the whole room by hand or from your VJ rig, in time with the music.

Who it's for

From an intimate first dance to a packed stadium — if you have a crowd and a song, you have a light show.

Give every guest a glowing role in the night.

Turn the whole field into your stage lighting.

Drop the beat and the whole floor flashes with it.

A shimmer of light wrapped around the first dance.

Light the room in your brand colors on cue.

Erupt the stands in color on every goal.

Unite the congregation in one moving moment.

The whole hall lights up for the big night.

Why it works

No wristbands to buy, ship, charge or collect. The lights are already in the crowd's hands.

One synchronized wave of light the whole crowd creates together — the kind of moment people film and remember.

No wristbands or LEDs to buy. It uses the phones people are already holding.

Guests just scan a QR and join in their browser. Nothing to download, nothing to sign up for.

Screen light works everywhere; on Android the real flashlight fires too — for an extra-bright wave.

Build the show around your music. Every flash lands exactly on the beat, in perfect sync.

Run the whole thing from a laptop. Build the playlist, project the QR, press GO.

Flash-rate limited with a photosensitivity warning and consent, so the show stays fun for everyone.

The control room

One laptop or tablet runs the whole show — from a single “GO” to VJ-grade live control, all in the browser.

Grab saturation, colour, brightness and flash and ride them under the music — like a VJ console, right in the browser. Open it fullscreen and mix with your fingers on a tablet.

Upload a track and the lights follow the music. Layer a separate camera-flash channel, fire one-tap synchronized fireworks, scroll a message across every phone, or hit BLACKOUT — the music keeps playing.

Restrict the whole crowd to a flag’s or a brand’s palette — pick colours on the wheel and everything snaps to the nearest one. Perfect for a product launch, a club night, or a team’s colours.

Already run Resolume, TouchOSC or Bitfocus Companion? Drive the crowd’s phones from the console you already use, over OSC — a tiny bridge runs on your own laptop, no cloud lock-in.

Use cases

A few ways people turn a crowd's phones into something unforgettable.

The chorus hits, you press GO, and in an instant five hundred phones flash gold in perfect unison — a single golden pulse rolling across the whole crowd, right on the downbeat.

As the couple steps onto the floor, every guest's phone breathes a soft warm shimmer around them — a glow that wraps the room without a single spotlight rig.

Three… two… one — the whole venue strobes brighter with every number, then explodes into a full-color burst as the clock hits zero.

The ball hits the net and the stands ignite — thousands of phones flashing your team's colors in a wave that circles the whole arena.

At the reveal, the entire room turns your exact brand color on cue — a launch image that lands in every attendee's camera roll.

How it works

No rigging, no installs, no rehearsal. From laptop to lit-up room in minutes.

You upload your playlist on a laptop and project a QR code on screen — or print it on the tickets.

People point their phone camera at the QR and join in seconds — straight in the browser, no app needed.

Hit GO and every phone flashes to the music, perfectly in sync — one light show across the whole room.

Pricing

The app is free and open-source (Apache-2.0) — self-host it with no limits, or try the hosted demo. The paid tiers are an optional managed service: we plan, set up, operate and tune your show on the night. Final scope is confirmed on a quick call.

Free

self-host or demo

Run the full app yourself with no limits — Docker, open source. Or try the hosted demo here. No per-person fee, no wristbands, no app for your crowd.

Spark

up to 100 phones

Parties, weddings, small venues — one operator, on good Wi-Fi.

Surge

up to 1,000 phones

Clubs, mid-size concerts, conferences — soundcheck + on-site operation.

Prices are starting points and depend on venue, audience size and network conditions — confirmed on a consult call. No payment here; every tier starts with a conversation.

Open the live demo, scan the QR with your phone, and watch your own screen join the show. Grab a few phones for the full effect.

Seen in the wild

It's a real moment people create — a wave of phone light across a stadium or a concert. Crowd Light Show turns it into a show you actually control: one operator drives every colour, flash and effect live, and the music plays in sync on every phone.

# Crowd Light Show

Source: https://lightshow.flyreelstudio.eu/join?demo=1

Twój telefon stanie się częścią wspólnego pokazu świateł zsynchronizowanego z muzyką.

Ten pokaz miga jasnym światłem. Nie dołączaj, jeśli masz padaczkę światłoczułą lub źle reagujesz na migające światło. Możesz wyjść w każdej chwili przyciskiem „Stop”.

Domyślnie świeci **ekran telefonu** (działa na każdym telefonie). Na Androidzie możesz dodatkowo włączyć **prawdziwą latarkę** — przeglądarka poprosi wtedy o dostęp do kamery. **Nie nagrywamy ani nie wysyłamy żadnego obrazu** — kamera służy wyłącznie do włączania diody.

Pokaz zużywa baterię, telefon może się nagrzać, a ekran pozostaje włączony. Trzymaj telefon ekranem do sceny i nie blokuj go.

🔆 Ustaw jasność na maksimum i trzymaj ekran w stronę sceny.
